riskExceptionsBulkImport.title: Risk Exceptions: Bulk Actions
riskExceptionsBulkImport.importHeading: Bulk Import: Exceptions from another tool
riskExceptionsBulkImport.templateIntro: -- one row per exception. Each gets a new BlueTrack Exception ID.
riskExceptionsBulkImport.ruleSource: {sourceTool}, {sourceExceptionId} (required): where it came from. The same tool and ID already imported is an error.
riskExceptionsBulkImport.ruleSourceUrl: {sourceUrl}: a link to it in that tool (http:// or https://).
riskExceptionsBulkImport.ruleScope: What it covers, exactly one of: {accountUserName} + {accountAddress} (both required, an exact match; an account without an address can't be matched), or {applicationCode}.
riskExceptionsBulkImport.ruleApproval: {justification}, {approvedByName} (the approver in that tool), {approvalDate}, {reviewDate} (required; dates as yyyy-MM-dd).
riskExceptionsBulkImport.ruleStatus: {status}: Active, Expired or Revoked (blank means Active). {externalTicketReference} is optional.
riskExceptionsBulkImport.ruleLink: {linkToAccountProgress}: Yes also sets an Active account exception's account to Risk Accepted / Excluded, linked to it (blank means No).
riskExceptionsBulkImport.summary: {total} rows -- {created} imported, {linked} linked to Account Progress, {errors} errors

targets.title: Targets
targets.intro: Any final destination an account's access leads to -- a server, database, application, or other endpoint. Risk score (0-1000) is always analyst-set here, regardless of how the row itself was created.
targets.deleteFailed: Delete failed: {status} (a target still referenced by an Access Group or Account mapping can't be deleted)
targets.sortHint: Click a column to sort by it; shift-click another column to add it as a secondary sort key.
targets.linkHeading: Link a Single Account to a Target

targetEdit.name: Name:
targetEdit.linkedToIntro: This target is linked to another, and is hidden from the Targets list unless linked targets are shown. Anything that reaches it counts as that target, at that target's risk score:
targetEdit.linkedTargetsIntro: Targets linked to this one. Anything that reaches them counts as this target, once, at this target's risk score.
targetEdit.unlinkWarning: It will count at its own risk score again, and won't be linked again automatically.
targetEdit.linkIntro: Link this target to another one (its primary) when they are the same thing under two names, for example the same server in two lists. They keep their own identifiers; together they count once, at the primary's risk score. A target that has targets linked to it, or is linked already, can't be linked.
targetEdit.linkWarning: It will count at the primary's risk score, and can be unlinked later.

targetsBulkImport.inventoryIntro: -- each row is matched against existing Targets by identifier (auto-merges on a strong match, e.g. ADGuid; a weak IP-only match is queued for review instead of auto-merging).
targetsBulkImport.inventorySummary: {total} rows -- {created} created, {merged} merged, {pending} pending review, {errors} errors.

accessGroups.title: Access Groups

accessGroups.sortHint: Click a column to sort by it; shift-click another column to add it as a secondary sort key.
